# Vestiaire Collective

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `core` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 26 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Public shop: public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: core.

Vestiaire Collective is a public second-hand fashion shop. This package is a signed-out capture of [https://www.vestiairecollective.com](https://www.vestiairecollective.com) on 2026-11-22. The live host redirected to [https://us.vestiairecollective.com/](https://us.vestiairecollective.com/). Desktop width measured 1440 by 900, `devicePixelRatio` 2. The homepage, Women, and About us were photographed. Nothing was typed, submitted, or signed in.

## Typography

14 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Albra-Regular, HelveticaNowText.

### Fonts (from README.md)

HelveticaNowText is the shop face (400, 500, and 700). Albra-Regular is the title face (400). The files are not in this package.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

This is the signed-out shop. Do not treat a product price, a sale price, or the currency as stable chrome. Prices on these pages were shown in SGD. The footer locale was not changed.

The product page prints a seller username in the first screen. It was measured and not photographed. The seller name and the product URL are not stored in this package.

HelveticaNowText and Albra-Regular are the computed faces. No font file is in this package. The style guide uses Georgia for titles and Helvetica for the shop.

[icon.png](icon.png) is the public android-chrome icon, resized from 192 px to 128 px. It is not a crop of the header wordmark.

Phone width was not captured. Hover and focus were not measured. Men, Designers, and the journal index were not opened.
